+def uncapped_credit(charge_cents):
+    """10% of the charge, rounded down separately per line to integer cents."""
+    return charge_cents * CREDIT_RATE_PERCENT // 100

+    """Assign release 1.0 credits to every line of one complete monthly statement.

+    remaining_by_account = {}

+        credit = min(uncapped_credit(line["charge_cents"]), remaining)

+        credits[line["line_id"]] = credit

Applies to every consumer of release 1.0 (single-line quote today; full statements later). Release "1.0" is the initial agreement; an omitted request release selects the current agreement, an explicit supported release selects that version, and versions introduced in an issue stay supported afterward. Public suites send explicit release values, so an earlier-release suite stays valid when the current agreement changes.

Charge line: exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id (nonempty strings; line_id unique per request), service_on (YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, never excludes a line), charge_cents (nonnegative integer US cents). Subscription identity is the pair (account_id, subscription_id); a subscription may have several lines. Each request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order = Unicode code-point order. Do not add response keys beyond those specified.

Credit rules (release 1.0): uncapped credit per line = floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), rounded down separately per line. Cap = 2400 cents shared by all lines with the same account_id across its subscriptions; distinct accounts have independent caps. Priority within a cap group: earliest service_on first, ties by increasing line_id. Each line gets its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines get only the remainder or zero. total_credit = sum of assigned credits; line amount due = charge - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit.
